bay.en: to make a long deep sound, especially while hunting

bench.en: a long seat for two or more people, usually made of wood

bench.zh: 法官；法官席位；法官（或裁判官）的职位
bench.en: a judge in court or the seat where he/she sits; the position of being a judge or magistrate

a.zh: （用于可数名词或单数名词前，表示未曾提到的）一（人、事、物）
a.en: used before countable or singular nouns referring to people or things that have not already been mentioned

a.zh: （用于前有形容词或后有短语的不可数名词前）
a.en: used before uncountable nouns when these have an adjective in front of them, or phrase following them

a.zh: 任何一；每一
a.en: any; every

a.zh: （表示为某一群体或职业中的一员）
a.en: used to show that sb/sth is a member of a group or profession

a.zh: （用于视为一体的两个名词之前）
a.en: used in front of two nouns that are seen as a single unit

a.zh: （用于某些数字前，代替 one）
a.en: used instead of one before some numbers

a.zh: （用于价格、数量、比率等）一，每一
a.en: used when talking about prices, quantities and rates

a.zh: 像（某人）的人；…式的人物
a.en: a person like sb

a.zh: （用于某人姓名前，表示说话者不认识此人）有个
a.en: used before sb's name to show that the speaker does not know the person

a.zh: （用于一星期中某天的名称前，表示具体某一天）
a.en: used before the names of days of the week to talk about one particular day

a.zh: 英语字母表的第 1 个字母
a.en: the first letter of the English alphabet

a.zh: A 音（C 大调音阶的第六级音）
a.en: the 6th note in the scale of C major

a.zh: （学业成绩）第一等，优，甲
a.en: the highest mark/grade that a student can get for a piece of work or course of study

a.zh: （表示两个或更多可能性中的）第一个
a.en: used to represent the first of two or more possibilities

a.zh: （代表一个假设的或不指名的人）甲
a.en: used to represent a person, for example in an imagined situation or to hide their identity

a.zh: 从一地到另一地
a.en: from one place to another

a.zh: 从头到尾；彻底地；完全
a.en: including everything there is to know about sth
